text:
Measured offline (no model calls) by a helper agent; script and JSON in .agent-work/evidence-binding-s0-evidence/s3b/ (ignored, local).
- Independent judgments exist only for the 4 body rows (503, 507, 526, 575; 12 frames). The original visual inspection was never saved as a record (prose in report.md only); the per-pair truth labels were assigned by the helper from contact sheets and are agent judgments, not gold. 30 of 34 rows have no judgment (no value, not low support).
- Low-pixel run: 43 valid pair records, 48 matches; bases same/continuous_view 27, unknown/insufficient 12, different/distinctive_geometry 4, different/insufficient 4 (all 4 refused by the symmetric basis check), different/continuous_view 1. 32 admitted definite edges, 2 judged.
- Judged: false different 1 of 2 truly-same definite claims in each run (row 507 frames 73->74; 95% CI 0.013-0.987); false same 0 of 0 (low-pixel, no value) and 0 of 1 (higher-pixel). The false different came from a misread body orientation (face-down read as face-up; the error moves between frames across runs). Link: produces. No valid assessor proposal cites an association item (consumes).
Decision for S3c: sampled-pair visual identity edges are admitted at most as contributory (AppearanceMatch-class), never sufficient; refuse different-edges whose basis is posture or orientation. A track-level source must show continuity over intervening frames with shot-cut detection, per-basis precision for same and different against frozen independent labels on a few dozen pairs beyond these rows, and no splitting of a static body on misread orientation. Cheap next step: an independent labeling pass over the existing 34-row contact sheets.
